parameters.name: USBVersion
parameters.description: USB specification version with which the device complies. Example: "1.1"

parameters.name: DeviceClass
parameters.description: Class Code as assigned by USB-IF. When 0x00, each device specifies its own class code. When 0xFF, the class code is vendor specified.

parameters.name: Port
parameters.description: Hub port on parent device. 0 when no parent.

parameters.name: USBPort
parameters.description: {{reference}} This is a reference to the USB host device to which this (external) USB device is connected.

parameters.name: Rate
parameters.description: Speed of the USB device. {{enum}} Internal signaling between the connected USB device and the USB Host Controller provide the information needed to determine the negotiated rate.

parameters.name: Parent
parameters.description: {{reference}} This is a reference to the parent USB device (e.g. hub device). This is {{empty}} for a device connected to the Host controller (root hub).

parameters.name: MaxChildren
parameters.description: Number of ports. Only applies for hub device, equal to 0 for other devices.

parameters.name: IsSuspended
parameters.description: When {{true}} the associated Device is in a suspended (i.e. low-power) state (see {{bibref|USB2.0|Chapter 11.9}}). When {{false}} the associated Device is in any of the other states specified by the USB 2.0 Device State Machine (see {{bibref|USB2.0|Chapter 9.1.1}}).

parameters.name: IsSelfPowered
parameters.description: When {{true}} the associated device is at least partly powered by a local source (see {{bibref|USB2.0|Chapter 9.4.5}}). When {{false}} the associated device draws all the current it needs from the USB bus.
